craft_notes: Sthāyin: Awe before capability (audārya). Em-dash→comma (marvel softens onto granting). Rejected: 'marvel!' exclamation — plain kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: A marvel — eyed awry, fancy-astray though it be,
ripe last yield, Lord, grant whole.
l4.sanskrit_cite: citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'pi vā paramārthaphalaṃ nātha paripūrṇaṃ prayacchasi
